item.title: White House asks for record-breaking $1.5 trillion for defense in new budget request
item.summary: The White House is asking Congress to approve roughly $1.5 trillion for defense -- a record-breaking amount as the U.S. remains in its fifth week of war with Iran.

item.title: WATCH: Father and son share special moment on World Autism Awareness Day
item.summary: ABC News' Danny New shares the special moment when ESPN analyst Dan Orlovsky brought his son Madden who has autism onto "NFL Live."

item.title: WATCH: Jobs report shows strong hiring in March, despite oil shock set off by Iran war
item.summary: The U.S. recorded strong job gains in March, rebounding from dismal losses, even as the nation weathered a global oil shock set off by the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, a jobs report on Friday showed.

item.title: US fighter jet down in Iran: 1 crew member rescued as search continues, officials say
item.summary: It appears that a U.S. fighter jet has been shot down by Iran and that the U.S. has launched a search and rescue effort, three U.S. officials confirmed to ABC News.

item.title: WATCH: Artemis II orbits Earth for full day, takes critical step in path towards the moon
item.summary: After a picture perfect lift-off and a full day of orbiting Earth, Artemis II has fired up the crucial translunar injection.

item.title: WATCH: American fighter jet appears to have been shot down by Iran, U.S. official says
item.summary: An American fighter jet appears to have been shot down by Iran. A search and rescue is underway, a U.S. official said.

item.summary: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

item.title: WATCH: One crew member from downed jet over Iran is rescued
item.summary: One crew member aboard the downed fighter jet over Iran has been rescued, according to a U.S. official.

item.title: WATCH: Search for American journalist kidnapped in Iraq
item.summary: A source says the FBI is now involved in the search for veteran American journalist Shelly Kittleson.

item.title: WATCH: KitKat launches tracker after chocolate heist
item.summary: Nestlé, the maker of KitKat, has launched a tracker in an attempt to find the 12 tons of stolen chocolate.
